# Agentic Media Lab

> Which skill, renderer and model to use when a coding agent makes your video - with runs you can repeat. Records: 194 (90 tool, 29 model, 75 source, 0 recipe). Concepts: 35. Pages: 11. Size: about 208776 tokens (estimate, characters / 4).

## Entry points

- [Index](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/INDEX.md): concept tree with counts and the hub size
- [Catalog](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/README.md): every record by kind, inactive records listed separately
- [Data schema](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/docs/SCHEMA.md): Use this page when you need the exact record fields, allowed values, id rules or how the evidence badge is derived.
- [Glossary](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/docs/glossary.md): Use this page when a term in the hub is unclear or you need a concept id.
- [All records as JSON lines](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/index/records.jsonl): the full machine dump
- [README.md](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/README.md): what the hub is
- [AGENTS.md](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/AGENTS.md): how agents query and extend the hub

## Guides

- [bb for scheduled Claude Code and Codex runs](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/docs/cards/bb.md): Use this page when you are deciding whether to schedule Claude Code or Codex runs with bb.
- [First render in a day with Claude Code](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/docs/cheatsheets/first-render-claude-code.md): Use this page when you want Claude Code to deliver its first rendered clip and need the install side effects, the still-frame step and the measurement in order.
- [What runs free on an Apple Silicon Mac](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/docs/cheatsheets/local-stack-apple-silicon.md): Use this page when you want to make video, images, speech, music or captions on an Apple Silicon Mac without a paid service and need to know what has a documented path and which licences bite.
- [What each platform requires for automated, AI-assisted posts from one developer's own account](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/docs/cheatsheets/publishing-rules.md): Use this page when you want to post agent-made clips to your own accounts through official APIs and need each platform's audit, limit and AI-label rules.
- [My agent-made video looks amateur: which skill fixes which problem](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/docs/cheatsheets/quality-skill-stack.md): Use this page when an agent-made clip looks amateur and you want to know which skill instructs the agent on the defect you see.
- [Run it on a schedule with an approval step](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/docs/cheatsheets/schedule-with-approval.md): Use this page when you want an agent pipeline to run on a timer and stop for a human approval before it publishes.
- [Fact-check results](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/docs/fact-check.md): Use this page when you need to know how far to trust a record's wording, or which research lanes were least accurate.
- [Where the skills contradict each other, and what the standards say](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/docs/research/skill-rule-conflicts.md): Use this page when two video skills give your agent opposite rules and you need to know which one a standard backs.
